Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

Face: wide triangular face; deep-set eyes and a heavy level brow; broad low bridge, full lips; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: gray-white-silver, short-textured-crop, deliberate accent: one clipped color panel. Wardrobe: mantle-short-cape, specifically a small mantle or short cape over an unarmored tunic and divided lower layers; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette rust-charcoal. Visible personal details: three hair rings. Make one clasp, buckle, piercing, or piece of hair hardware the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: severe grooming softened by one unruly feature. Color treatment: lets faded and repaired areas vary the palette. Pose cue: chin remains level while one hand lightly checks a cuff seam. Include a worn spool of colored thread only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.
